newsitem.title: USA: Executive Jet orders Raytheon aircrafts.
newsitem.headline: Executive Jet orders Raytheon aircrafts.

text.p: Raytheon Aircraft said Executive Jet Inc. ordered 20 Hawker 800XP aircrafts valued at more than $210 million.
Raytheon said Executive Jet has options for 10 more Hawker 800XP jets and has purchased an additional Hawker 1000 that was initially used for certification testing and flight demonstrations.
Raytheon said this is the single largest business jet order for Hawkers in the aircraft's history.

Executive Jet will use the mid-sized Hawker aircraft for its NetJets fractional aircraft ownership operation, a programme that enables companies to buy shares in business jets, in a manner similar to holiday time-shares.
NetJets will accept delivery of its first two Raytheon Aircraft-built Hawker 800XPs later this year, with the remaining aircraft to be delivered over the next five years.
Executive Jet, based in Montvale, N.J., manages a fleet of Hawker business jets for corporate and individual clients. Last year, the company introduced a similar programme in Europe.
Raytheon Aircraft, based in Wichita, Kansas, is a subsidiary of Lexington, Mass.-based Raytheon Co.
